name: Gakvu
source:
Gakvu, also known as Gakvukani, is a Vel Qou Obesk who worked in the Embassy in the Call Research Initiative alongside Akizet.

She previously worked on the Okizika, a religious monument on Obeski, when she was larval.

[Based on [url=https://corru.wiki/wiki/Gakvu]Corru Observer Wiki[/url]]
